name: Veterinary Front-Desk Operations
audience: independent veterinary clinics and small client-service teams
topic: client follow-up and callback workflows for veterinary clinics

products.name: Treatment Follow-Up Queue
products.product: A focused veterinary client treatment follow-up tracking workflow that makes ownership, evidence, exceptions, and the next action visible.
products.audience: independent veterinary clinics and small client-service teams
products.problem: Routine post-visit check-ins are easy to miss when clinical instructions are in the patient record but callback promises sit in personal task lists.
products.valueProposition: Turns veterinary client treatment follow-up tracking into a visible operating queue so every clinician-requested follow-up reaches the client, records the response, and routes concerns back to the care team.
products.monetization: $19-$99/month based on active records, locations, or team size
products.startupCost: Static product probe, managed database, email integration, and lightweight scheduled jobs.
products.seoAngle: Targets veterinary follow up calls, vet client callback tracker, post visit veterinary follow up, and veterinary communication workflow searches.

products.name: Lab Callback Board
products.product: A focused veterinary lab result callback tracking workflow that makes ownership, evidence, exceptions, and the next action visible.
products.audience: independent veterinary clinics and small client-service teams
products.problem: Result availability, clinician review, and client communication are separate events, so staff can see a result without knowing whether the owner was actually informed.
products.valueProposition: Turns veterinary lab result callback tracking into a visible operating queue so every expected result is reviewed by the assigned clinician and communicated to the client with a documented next step.
products.monetization: $19-$99/month based on active records, locations, or team size
products.startupCost: Static product probe, managed database, email integration, and lightweight scheduled jobs.
products.seoAngle: Targets veterinary lab callback, vet result tracking, lab result client notification, and veterinary callback workflow searches.
